summary: It is a space mission design game where one can choose the equipment they intend to use in the given mission, manage fuel, trajectory and so on. One can land on the surface of the moon, mars and can also dock the module and explore the International Space Station.
details: It is a game that focuses on different aspects of launching a vehicle into space, starting from the ground to the space. It can be used to explore an environment where one can tinker around with different aspects of a space mission. HTML, CSS and JavaScript were primarily used in its creation. The project is creative because it gives the player the ability to explore a sandbox, where the only limit is their imagination. Accessibility was the major factors that the team took into consideration while building this.
